posts.title: HEAT SIGN KYLOR KELLEY AND GABE MADSEN
posts.author: Miami HEAT
posts.summary: Following tonight’s preseason win against the New Orleans Pelicans, your Miami HEAT announced that they have signed center Kylor Kelley and guard Gabe Madsen and waived J’Vonne Hadley and Lester Quiñones. In a subsequent move, Miami also signed and waived Dennis Smith Jr. Per club policy, terms of the deals were not disclosed.
facts: Following tonight’s preseason win against the New Orleans Pelicans, your Miami HEAT announced that they have signed center Kylor Kelley and guard Gabe Madsen and waived J’Vonne Hadley and Lester Quiñones.
In a subsequent move, Miami also signed and waived Dennis Smith Jr.

He scored in double-figures nine times and blocked multiple shots 10 times.

He also appeared in 11 career NBA games with Dallas and New Orleans during the 2024-25 season, totaling 34 points, 39 rebounds, five assists, three blocks and a steal while shooting 63.6 percent from the field.

He scored in double-figures 17 times, including two 20-point performances.
He scored a season-high 27 points against the Texas Legends on February 1 and posted a 14-point, 11-rebound double-double against the Salt Lake City Stars on January 18.
